name: fred_leading_index
description:
The OECD composite leading indicator for the United States (amplitude adjusted, long-term average = 100, monthly), FRED series USALOLITOAASTSAM; it replaces the Philadelphia Fed Leading Index (USSLIND), discontinued in 2020.
Returns {"series": "USALOLITOAASTSAM", "data": <FRED observations response>}; data.observations = [{date (YYYY-MM-DD), value (a string, "." if missing), realtime_start, realtime_end}], newest first; data is {"error": ...} if the call fails.
Inputs (* required): series_id (default USALOLITOAASTSAM), limit (newest observations; default 20).
Related: fred_yield_spread, fred_consumer_sentiment.
Example: {"series_id": "USALOLITOAASTSAM", "limit": 20}

series_id.description: FRED series id; defaults to this tool's series

limit.description: Number of most recent observations to return (newest first)
